title: Bachmann N Scale Central Pacific R.R. Old Time Coach Car #3
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Model Railroads & Trains:Railroads & Trains:Passenger Cars
descriptionText:
Bachmann N scale old-time passenger coach, Central Pacific R.R., car #3. Wood-sided design with clerestory roof, typical of the golden-spike era.
Used, no original box — no visible damage noted, please review photos closely. Ships well-packed.
